summary: Reproduced that VisionTritonAttention silently computed full attention without sinks when given MiMo-style window_size and s_aux, then added sliding-window masking and per-query-head sink logits to the Triton varlen prefill kernel and forwarded both backend arguments. The regression now agrees with an independent PyTorch softmax reference on gfx950.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the hand-computed oracle and legacy full-attention kernel calibration passed, while VisionTritonAttention disagreed with the window-and-sink reference because it dropped both kwargs. Raw output: reports/j-956e818f217c/raw/baseline_reproduction.log

Passing-after numerical regression on MI350X/gfx950: 13 tests passed and the NVIDIA Hopper-only FA3 cross-check skipped. Tests compare BF16 Triton output with an independent FP32 PyTorch reference and cover window-only, sink-only, combined semantics, ragged varlen, GQA, causal composition, one-sided and small multi-block windows, NaN resistance, backend forwarding, and invalid sink shape. Raw output: reports/j-956e818f217c/raw/fixed_full_regression_final.log
Seven existing VisionTritonAttention max-sequence-length and metadata tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-956e818f217c/raw/vision_max_seqlen.log
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, secrets, and registered-test taxonomy checks passed. Raw output: reports/j-956e818f217c/raw/precommit_second.log

gpu_evidence: Executed the Triton kernel and backend numerical regressions on the single assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950, ROCm 7.2 GPU. Hardware record: reports/j-956e818f217c/raw/gpu_info.log
remaining_limitations: No MiMo-V2.5 weights were available, so no full-model serving or semantic-quality reproduction was claimed; validation is at the actual VisionTritonAttention and Triton kernel layers.
The assigned GPU is AMD gfx950, not the NVIDIA B40/H20 hardware from the report.
The FlashAttention3 comparison requires NVIDIA Hopper and was skipped; the independent FP32 PyTorch reference supplies the numerical oracle on this host.
No native C++ or FlyDSL component was changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
